title: Barreltone
html_source: Base-Barreltone: play on words. A bass-baritone is a male singer who has a low baritone or a high bass. They have baritone qualities to their voice, but can reach into deeper, true bass pitches when the musical repertoire requires it.

anchor.prefix: s for ordinary things on account of the sound. She's not exactly witty. Can be rude too. Blurt out what I was thinking. Still, I don't know. She used to say Ben Dollard had a base
anchor.suffix: voice. He has legs like barrels and you'd think he was singing into a barrel. Now, isn't that wit. They used to call him big Ben. Not half as witty as calling him base barreltone.
